page.layout: Two printed pages. Left page: one column of Hebrew-Latin lexicon entries, with the catchword-line and signature "S f" at the foot. Right page: one column of entries, with the catchword "נקני" at the foot right. Page number "321" at the head right of the right page. No margin notes.

main_text.p: נִקְטָה fastidio est, נִקְטוּ fastidio sunt, (tanquam à קָטַט, pro נִקְּטוּ,)
נִקְטֶם fastidio estis, præt. Niph. 3. f. f. & 3. pl. & 2. pl. m. à 3. f. m. נִקְטוּ ; Rad. קוּט.
נָקִי, נְקִיָּא, נְקִיּוֹן mundus, נְקִיּוּת munditia, No. sing. m. Rad. נָקָה mundus fuit.
נְקִיִּים, vel נְקִיִּים innocentes, pl. m. No. נָקִי innocens, Rad. נָקָה.
נִקְצָנָה tædio afficiamus, fut. Hiph. 1. plur. aff. Rad. קוּץ.
וּמִנְּקִיקֵי & de foraminibus, No. pl. m. præf. à f. m. No. Rad. נָקִיק foramen.
נִקִּיתִי insons fuisti, נִקִּיתִי insons fui, pret. Niph, 2. f.m. & 1. f. Rad. נָקָה.
נִקִּיתִי mundavi, praet. Piel, 1. f. R. נָקָה.
est, נִקְלָה levis habita est, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & f. vel, Part. Niph. f. m. & f. Rad. קלל levari.
נִקְלָה vilis habitus est, • נִקְלָה vilis habitus, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & Part. Niph. f. m. R. קלה af-savit.
וַתִּנְקַלְתִּי & levem habuero me, præt. Niph. 1. f. præf. Rad. קלל.
נְקָמוּ ultionem sumserunt, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. נָקַם.
נְקֹמֶת ulciscens, Ben. Kal, f. f. Rad. נָקַם.
נְקַמְתִּי ultionem sumsero, præt. Niph. vel Piel, 1. f. Rad. נָקַם.
נִקְמָתִי ultio mea, נִקְמָתָם illorum, נִקְמָתֵנוּ nostra, sing. fæm. aff. No. נִקְמָה, Rad. נָקַם ultus est.
נְקָנָה comparatus est, prçt. Niph. 3. f. m. R. קנה.

page.notes: Hebrew forms are copied from a small scan and are doubtful in their vowel points and some consonants; several are uncertain and should be checked against the page. "af-savit" at the line end of the right page is uncertain (the second part may read "favit"). The left page carries no page number; the right page number "321" is read from a worn print. Running heads are read as Hebrew letters and may be [?].
